questions.question: A water tank can be filled in 19 minutes by using 39 pipes of the same capacity . In how many minutes (rounded off to two decimal places) will the water tank be filled if we use 23 pipes of the same capacity as above?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

39 pipes fill tank in 19 min

23 pipes fill tank in ? min

**Formula used:**

Time propto (1)/({Number of pipes)}

T₂ = T₁ × (P₁)/(P₂)

**Calculation:**

T₂ = 19 × (39)/(23)

⇒ T₂ = (741)/(23)

⇒ T₂ = 32.22 min

**∴ Tank will be filled in 32.22 min**

questions.question: If the selling price of a bed is 2-times of initial, then the profit is 8-times of initial. Find the initial profit percentage (in %).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

S.P.(new) = 2 × S.P.(initial)

Profit(new) = 8 × Profit(initial)

**Formula used:**

Profit = S.P. − C.P.

Profit% = (Profit / C.P.) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let initial C.P. = y, initial profit = x

S.P.(initial) = y + x

S.P.(new) = 2(y + x)

Profit(new) = 2(y + x) − y = y + 2x

Given: y + 2x = 8x

⇒ y = 6x

Initial Profit% = (x / 6x) × 100

⇒ 16.67%

**∴ Initial profit percentage = 16.67%**

questions.question: A group of people consists of men, women and children. Among them, 20% are men, 30% are women and the rest are children, and their average weights are 50 kg, 40 kg and 30 kg, respectively. The average weight of the group (in kg) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of men = 20%

Percentage of women = 30%

Percentage of children = 100% - (20% + 30%) = 50%

Average weight of men = 50 kg

Average weight of women = 40 kg

Average weight of children = 30 kg

**Formula used:**

Average weight of the group = (Percentage of men × Average weight of men) + (Percentage of women × Average weight of women) + (Percentage of children × Average weight of children)

**Calculation:**

Average weight of the group = (20/100 × 50) + (30/100 × 40) + (50/100 × 30)

⇒ Average weight of the group = (10) + (12) + (15) = 37 kg

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

Number of patients (Frequency) = [11, 18, 22, 30, 40, 16, 33]

**Formula used:**

Median = L + dfrac{((N)/(2) - CF)}{f} × h

Where:

• N = Total frequency
 
• CF = Cumulative frequency before the median class
 
• f = Frequency of the median class
 
• h = Class width

**Calculations:**

⇒ N = 170

Median class: Class interval containing dfrac{N}{2} = 85

Cumulative frequency:

[11, 11+18=29, 29+22=51, 51+30=81, 81+40=121, 121+16=137, 137+33=170]

Class interval containing 85: 55-65

Values for formula:

L = 55, CF = 81, f = 40, h = 10

Median = 55 + dfrac{(85 - 81)}{40} × 10

⇒ Median = 55 + dfrac{4}{40} × 10

⇒ Median = 55 + 1

⇒ Median = 56

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: Which of the following is the greatest number that divides 137 and 198 and leaves 7 and 3 as respective remainders?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The greatest number that divides 137 and 198, leaving remainders 7 and 3 respectively.

**Formula used:**

The required number is the HCF of (137 - 7) and (198 - 3).

**Calculation:**

137 - 7 = 130

198 - 3 = 195

⇒ Find the HCF of 130 and 195.

Prime factorization:

130 = 2 × 5 × 13

195 = 3 × 5 × 13

Common factors: 5, 13

⇒ HCF = 5 × 13 = 65

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: If the third proportional of 40 and Z is 10, then what is the positive value of Z?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Third proportional of 40 and Z is 10.

**Formula used:**

If A, B, and C are in continued proportion, then B² = A × C.

**Calculation:**

40, Z, and 10 are in continued proportion.

⇒ Z² = 40 × 10

⇒ Z² = 400

⇒ Z = √400

⇒ Z = 20

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 17 km/hr and the speed of the stream is 16 km/hr. A man rows to a place at a distance of 26.4 km and comes back to the starting point. Find the total time (in hours) taken by him.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed in still water = 17 km/hr

Speed of stream = 16 km/hr

Distance (one way) = 26.4 km

**Formula used:**

Downstream speed = u + v

Upstream speed = u - v

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

Downstream speed = 17 + 16 = 33 km/hr

Upstream speed = 17 - 16 = 1 km/hr

Downstream time = 26.4 ÷ 33 = 0.8 hr

Upstream time = 26.4 ÷ 1 = 26.4 hr

Total time = 0.8 + 26.4 = 27.2 hr

**∴ Total time taken = 27.2 hr**

questions.question: A and B complete a work in 18 days. If A alone can do it in 24 days, then B alone can do one-fourth of the same work in_______ days.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 18 days

A alone = 24 days

**Formula used:**

Work rate = 1 / Time

**Calculation:**

A's 1 day work = 1/24

(A + B)'s 1 day work = 1/18

⇒ B's 1 day work = 1/18 − 1/24

⇒ B's 1 day work = (4 − 3) / 72 = 1/72

B alone can do full work in 72 days

1/4 work ⇒ 72 × 1/4 = 18 days

**∴ B alone can do 1/4 work in 18 days.**

questions.question: If at the same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹40 and compound interest, compounded annually, is 41, then what is the principal (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SI (2 years) = ₹40

CI (2 years) = ₹41

**Formula used:**

Difference (CI − SI for 2 years) = P × (R/100)²

**Calculation:**

Difference = 41 − 40 = 1

⇒ P × (R/100)² = 1 ...(1)

SI for 1 year = ₹20 ⇒ P × R / 100 = 20 ...(2)

From (2), R/100 = 20 / P

Substitute in (1): P × (20/P)² = 1

⇒ 400 / P = 1

⇒ P = 400

**∴ Principal = ₹400**

questions.question: Let a be an odd positive integer. If the roots of a quadratic equation x² - (a - 1)x + 4a + 7 = 0 are integers, then the least value of a is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let a be odd positive integer

Quadratic: x² − (a − 1)x + 4a + 7 = 0

Roots integers ⇒ let roots = m, n (integers)

**Formula used:**

Sum = m + n = a − 1

Product = m × n = 4a + 7

**Calculation:**

⇒ a = m + n + 1

⇒ m × n = 4(m + n + 1) + 7

⇒ m × n = 4m + 4n + 11

⇒ m × n − 4m − 4n = 11

⇒ (m − 4)(n − 4) = 11 + 16 = 27

Factors of 27: 1 × 27, 3 × 9, (and negatives)

Case 1: u = 1, v = 27 ⇒ m = 1 + 4 = 5, n = 27 + 4 = 31

⇒ a = m + n + 1 = 5 + 31 + 1 = 37

Case 2: u = 3, v = 9 ⇒ m = 7, n = 13

⇒ a = 7 + 13 + 1 = 21

Negative factor pairs give a ≤ 0 (discard)

**∴ Least positive odd a = 21.**

questions.question: A man takes 13 hours to swim 91 km downstream. He swims 39 km upstream in the same time. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance downstream = 91 km

Distance upstream = 39 km

Time = 13 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed downstream = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream

Speed upstream = Speed of boat in still water - Speed of stream

Let speed of boat in still water = x km/hr and speed of stream = y km/hr.

**Calculations:**

Speed downstream = 91 ÷ 13 = 7 km/hr

Speed upstream = 39 ÷ 13 = 3 km/hr

⇒ x + y = 7

⇒ x - y = 3

Adding the two equations:

⇒ (x + y) + (x - y) = 7 + 3

⇒ 2x = 10

⇒ x = 5

The speed of the boat in still water is 5 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: The ratio of three numbers is 10: 15:13. If 10 percent of the first number is 66, what would be 50 percent of the difference of the third and second number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio = 10 : 15 : 13

10% of first number = 66

**Formula used:**

First = 10k, Second = 15k, Third = 13k

Percentage = (Value × percent)/100

**Calculation:**

10% of 10k = 66

⇒ (10 × 10k) / 100 = 66

⇒ k = 66

Second = 15 × 66 = 990

Third = 13 × 66 = 858

Positive Difference = |858 − 990| = 132

50% of difference = (50 × (132)) / 100 = 66

**∴ Required value = 66**

questions.question: An article's cost price is ₹300, and the marked price is mentioned as ₹1,032. What is the profit percentage of the seller if he sells it by allowing a discount of 50% on the marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹300

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1,032

Discount = 50%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount/100)

Profit Percentage = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

SP = ₹1,032 × (1 - 50/100)

⇒ SP = ₹1,032 × 0.5 = ₹516

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ Profit = ₹516 - ₹300 = ₹216

Profit Percentage = (Profit / CP) × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = (₹216 / ₹300) × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = 72%

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: The average of first 17 multiples of 13 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The first 17 multiples of 13

**Formula used:**

The average of first n multiples of a number = (n × number) / n

Here, Average = (Sum of first 17 multiples of 13) / 17

**Calculations:**

Sum of first 17 multiples of 13 = 13 × (1 + 2 + 3 + ... + 17)

⇒ Sum of first 17 natural numbers = n(n+1)/2 = 17(17+1)/2 = 17 × 18 / 2 = 153

⇒ Sum of first 17 multiples of 13 = 13 × 153 = 1989

⇒ Average = 1989 / 17 = 117

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: 15 chairs and 3 tables cost ₹7,800 and 14 chairs and 6 tables cost ₹9,200. What is the cost of 17 chairs and 18 tables?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

15 chairs and 3 tables cost ₹7,800

14 chairs and 6 tables cost ₹9,200

**Formula used:**

Let the cost of 1 chair = ₹x and the cost of 1 table = ₹y.

**Calculation:**

The first equation:

⇒ 15x + 3y = 7800

⇒ Divide by 3: 5x + y = 2600 … (1)

The second equation:

⇒ 14x + 6y = 9200

⇒ Divide by 2: 7x + 3y = 4600 … (2)

Multiply equation (1) by 3:

⇒ 15x + 3y = 7800 … (3)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (3):

⇒ (15x + 3y) - (7x + 3y) = 7800 - 4600

⇒ 8x = 3200 ⇒ x = 400

Substitute x = 400 into equation (1):

⇒ 5(400) + y = 2600

⇒ y = 600

Now, cost of 17 chairs and 18 tables:

⇒ 17x + 18y

⇒ 17(400) + 18(600)

⇒ 6800 + 10800 = 17600

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question:
The volume of a right circular cylinder is 4851 cm³ and its curved surface area is 462 cm². If this cylinder is generated by rotating a rectangle about its length by 360°, what will be the perimeter (in cm) of this rectangle?

Use pi = (22)/(7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume (V) = 4851 cm³

Curved surface area (CSA) = 462 cm²

**Formula used:**

Volume of a right circular cylinder = π r² h

CSA of a right circular cylinder = 2 π r h

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(h + r)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa37417c295b8a3d6d9f82c1027283de649f1424654279d49f885ac53690548c.png] 

From CSA: 2 times (22)/(7) times r times h = 462

⇒ r times h = (462 times 7)/(44) = 73.5

From V: (22)/(7) times r² times h = 4851

⇒ r² times h = (4851 times 7)/(22) = 1543.5

Divide: (r² h)/(r h) = (1543.5)/(73.5)

⇒ r = 21 {cm}

⇒ h = (73.5)/(21) = 3.5 {cm}

Perimeter = 2 times (h + r) = 2 times (3.5 + 21) = 2 times 24.5 = 49

**∴ Perimeter of the rectangle = 49 cm**
